text: Air emissions shall meet ER-14.02 and the EIA decision at the stack (65 m, EIA decision per the approved dispersion study); the values above apply to natural gas at the stated load range and to LDO firing for not more than 500 h/year; emissions shall be measured continuously by CEMS per EN 14181 (QAL1 certified per EN 15267-3, sampling location per EN 15259) with on-line reporting; the SCR ammonia slip shall be controlled at the stack to the limit above.
